$comment: The pinned toolchain. Every ticket in the Solana plan builds against this set.
Resolved 2026-08-10. Do not bump casually - Anchor/Agave/Rust compatibility is
the most fragile part of a Solana setup, and the ENC program ships
non-upgradeable, so a build-time surprise is expensive.
anchor 1.1.2  - latest; requires Rust >=1.89; built against solana-* 3.x crates.
agave 3.1.10  - NOT 4.x, even though Agave's latest is 4.2.0. This is the
version `avm install 1.1.2` pulls down for itself, which is the
authoritative answer rather than an inference; it matches
4.1.2 first just gets silently overwritten by avm.
rust 1.97.1   - NOT 1.90, and not the 1.89 that anchor-lang advertises as its
MSRV. Building avm 1.1.2 pulls cargo-platform 0.3.3, which
requires rustc >=1.91; on 1.90 the build dies with an error
naming a crate you have never heard of. Verified: avm and
